facts.fact: The Speed page on the ChatGPT Learn docs site was published on 11 November 2026 at 10:34:32 GMT.
Codex Fast mode speeds up GPT-5.6 by 1.5x, according to the page.
facts.quote: For GPT-5.6, the speed increase is 1.5x.

facts.fact: For supported models, Fast mode uses included subscription limits at 2.5x the Standard rate.
facts.quote: For supported models, Fast mode uses included subscription limits at 2.5x the Standard rate.

facts.fact: Fast mode bills purchased credits and Enterprise pay-as-you-go usage at 2x the Standard rate.
facts.quote: Purchased credits and Enterprise pay-as-you-go usage are billed at 2x the Standard rate.

facts.fact: GPT-6 Astra Ultrafast generates tokens up to 8x faster than GPT-6 Astra in Standard mode in Codex, per the vendor.
facts.quote: GPT-6 Astra Ultrafast generates tokens up to 8x faster than GPT-6 Astra in Standard mode in Codex.

facts.fact: Ultrafast mode bills purchased credits and Enterprise pay-as-you-go usage at 6x the Standard rate.
facts.quote: Ultrafast mode bills purchased credits and Enterprise pay-as-you-go usage at 6x the Standard rate.

facts.fact: Ultrafast uses included subscription limits at 8x the Standard rate.
facts.quote: Ultrafast uses included subscription limits at 8x the Standard rate.

facts.fact: Ultrafast is available in Codex and ChatGPT Work on Pro $500 and eligible Enterprise and Edu plans.
facts.quote: Ultrafast is available in Codex and ChatGPT Work on Pro $500 and eligible Enterprise and Edu plans.

facts.fact: Other self-serve plans do not have access to Ultrafast at launch, even with purchased credits.
facts.quote: Other self-serve plans don’t have access to Ultrafast at launch, even with purchased credits.

facts.fact: For Enterprise workspaces, Ultrafast is off by default, and workspace owners can enable it for selected users or the workspace.
facts.quote: For Enterprise workspaces, Ultrafast is off by default.

facts.fact: Eligible Edu plans use credits for Ultrafast, and legacy Enterprise plans that rely on rate limits instead of usage-based billing are not supported.
facts.quote: Eligible Edu plans use credits. Legacy Enterprise plans that rely on rate limits instead of usage-based billing aren’t supported.

facts.fact: GPT-6.1 Sol Ultrafast supports inference residency in the United States and Europe (EEA + Switzerland).
facts.quote: GPT-6.1 Sol Ultrafast supports inference residency in the United States and Europe (EEA + Switzerland).

facts.fact: GPT-6 Astra Ultrafast supports inference residency in the United States only.
facts.quote: GPT-6 Astra Ultrafast supports inference residency in the United States only.

facts.fact: GPT-5.5 retires from Codex with ChatGPT sign-in on October 14, 2026, at noon PDT (19:00 UTC).
facts.quote: from Codex with ChatGPT sign-in on October 14, 2026, at noon PDT (19:00 UTC)

facts.fact: With an API key, Codex uses API token pricing and ChatGPT credit multipliers do not apply.
facts.quote: With an API key, Codex uses API token pricing instead, and ChatGPT credit multipliers don’t apply.
